data.title: 陈千语 · 檐廊夕阳下的茶香独酌
data.description: 终末地基地后方幽静的木质檐廊，暮色金辉浸染着远方起伏的山脉。陈千语身着透气柔软的深青色亚麻茶服，领口微松展现出精致优美的锁骨与雪颈。她单手托腮跪坐在席垫上，细品着杯中泛起微光的清茶，微风拂动乌黑的高马尾，冷峻的神色在黄昏中渐渐融化为脉脉温情。
data.location: traditional wooden porch overlooking garden at sunset
data.action: sitting gracefully on wooden porch with loose linen tea robe, holding ceramic cup, sunset breeze fluttering black ponytail, calm affectionate gaze at viewer
data.lighting: dazzling orange and gold sunset lighting casting warm highlights on linen and skin
data.mood: tranquil martial grace, serene unhurried romance
data.promptProse: Sitting gracefully on a wooden porch as the sun sets over distant mountains, Chen Qianyu wears a relaxed linen robe. A cool breeze flutters her black ponytail as she cradles a teacup with calm, tender eyes.
data.animaCaption: Chen Qianyu drinking tea on a wooden porch against a brilliant mountain sunset.
